name: Husqvarna PG 6 XR
summary: Remote-controlled four-disc planetary floor grinder with a 600 mm grinding width, for preparing, grinding and polishing concrete and stone floors in smaller areas.

germany.statusNote: Listed on Husqvarna Construction's German website with an EU article number and 'Angebot anfordern', dealer search and demo booking. Profi-Bau-Shop (Germany) sells it online at 28,899.16 € excl. VAT (article 970604403, delivery 3-5 working days), the same price it shows for the PG 6 DR.

priceEur.note: Profi-Bau-Shop, article 970604403, excl. VAT (UVP shown higher), delivery 3-5 working days. The shop lists the same price for the PG 6 DR.

specs.quote: Bei der Vier-Scheiben-Technologie drehen sich zwei Schleifscheibenpaare gegeneinander, wodurch die PG 6 XR gut ausbalanciert ist und hocheffizient arbeitet.

notes: Remote-controlled, not autonomous: the operator drives the machine with a joystick remote control that shows power use, input current and motor speed in real time.
Mains-powered for grinding (3-phase); built-in batteries and charger power transport moves on and to the site; fold-out transport wheel.
Mist Cooler water-mist system and adjustable built-in weights for grinding pressure; Husqvarna Fleet Services ready.
